note: Saint-Barthélemy: residence as a non-citizen is France's, under the Code of Entry and Stay of Foreigners and of the Right of Asylum (CESEDA) with the adaptations the code makes for the collectivity (the ordinance of 16 December 2020 made the code expressly applicable there, as in Saint-Martin), its residence titles handled by the State's prefecture of Saint-Barthélemy and Saint-Martin on France's online service for foreigners (ANEF). Read on 2026-10-30 in the Government's amendment no. 1655 to the 3DS bill in the Senate (2020-2021), which states where the code applies, and on the prefecture's own page announcing that from 1 February 2027 renewals of residence titles (except those marked 'salarié', 'entrepreneur / profession libérale' and 'travailleur temporaire') are to be made only on the ANEF (updated 28 October 2026). The code itself on Légifrance answers this client with a bot check and wasn't read, nor the collectivity's adaptations.

sources.title: Sénat, projet de loi 3DS, amendement n° 1655 du Gouvernement (2020-2021), objet
sources.said: si les dispositions du CESEDA étaient déjà applicables en Guadeloupe, en Guyane, en Martinique, à Mayotte, à La Réunion, à Saint-Pierre-et-Miquelon, à Saint-Barthélemy et à Saint-Martin ... cette même ordonnance a expressément rendu applicables les dispositions du code, avec les adaptations nécessaires, à Saint-Barthélemy et à Saint-Martin.
